# MCP tools

<!-- Generated by tools/mcp_tool_reference.py from manifests/mcp_tools.json; do not edit. -->

The tools every GUI.Forms program serves under `--mcp` ([hosts and capabilities](hosts-and-capabilities.md)), as a built program lists them. A program adds its own beside them with `register_model_tool`; those are named `<program>.<tool>` and are not listed here. Every tool refuses an argument its schema does not name.

## `windows`

**Windows.** Every window: stable ID, title, active, modal, size.

No arguments.

## `snapshot`

**Snapshot.** The control tree as an outline: role, name, [stable ID], states, value, the actions each node takes and what its press opens (needs_user: it opens a dialog the user answers; instead= names a tool that does the same without one). A virtualised list says how many rows it does not show. Narrow it with root and filter; actions false leaves the actions out.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `root` | string | no |  |
| `filter` | string | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |
| `bounds` | boolean | no |  |
| `actions` | boolean | no |  |

## `find`

**Find.** Nodes by role, name (any case, part of it) and state, each with its [stable ID] and parent; cheaper than a snapshot when you know what you look for.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `role` | string | no |  |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `state` | string | no |  |
| `within` | string | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

## `act`

**Act.** A semantic action on a node (press, select, expand, collapse, focus, set_value, increment, decrement, show_menu, close), scroll_into_view, or invoke_command on a command's stable ID. A row a virtualised list does not show is reached by its ID. A dialog you opened may be closed (close on the dialog, as Cancel), never submitted. Waits for idle and replies with what changed; terse gives counts.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `action` | one of `press`, `select`, `expand`, `collapse`, `focus`, `set_value`, `increment`, `decrement`, `show_menu`, `close`, `scroll_into_view`, `invoke_command` | no |  |
| `value` | string | no |  |
| `terse` | boolean | no |  |

## `reset`

**Reset.** Puts the interface back in order: closes the dialogs you opened (as Cancel), popups and menus, tooltips and drags, releases pointer capture and a hold, and stops content that froze; replies with what it reset and what it left (a dialog the user opened).

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |

## `pointer`

**Pointer.** Pointer input through the program's own input path: move, hover, click, double_click, right_click, down, up, drag, wheel; at a target (offset inside it, default its centre) or a window position.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `action` | one of `move`, `hover`, `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `down`, `up`, `drag`, `wheel` | no |  |
| `offset` | object | no |  |
| `position` | object | no |  |
| `path` | array of object | no |  |
| `button` | one of `primary`, `secondary`, `middle` | no |  |
| `modifiers` | array of string | no |  |
| `delta` | object | no |  |
| `terse` | boolean | no |  |

## `keyboard`

**Keyboard.** Key chords ("Ctrl+S") and sequences, committed text, and composition, to the focused control or to a target focused first.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `keys` | string or array | no |  |
| `text` | string | no |  |
| `composition` | object | no |  |
| `terse` | boolean | no |  |

## `text`

**Text.** A node's whole text: a text control's value, selection and lines (with select, sets the selection, UTF-8 byte offsets); any other node's full name, value and description, such as a label cut in the outline.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `select` | object | no |  |

## `wait`

**Wait.** Waits until the next frame, idle, a time (ms), a condition on a node (state, value, exists) or a user step done.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `until` | one of `frame`, `idle`, `ms`, `node`, `user_step` | no |  |
| `ms` | number | no |  |
| `timeout_ms` | number | no |  |
| `state` | string | no |  |
| `value` | string | no |  |
| `exists` | boolean | no |  |
| `step` | string | no |  |

## `capture`

**Capture.** A window or control as a PNG, drawn fresh from the current state; a window's open popup windows (menus, drop-downs) and its tooltip window are composited over it unless popups is false. Password fields are painted out.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `mode` | one of `rendered` | no |  |
| `scale` | number | no |  |
| `margin` | number | no |  |
| `include_overlays` | boolean | no |  |
| `popups` | boolean | no |  |

## `inspect`

**Inspect.** Beyond accessibility, sections chosen with what: state, layout, paint, metrics, dispatcher, interaction, session, schema, clipboard, summary, layout_reasons, resources, events. With a target, state, layout and schema by default; without, metrics, dispatcher and interaction.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | string | no | a window's stable ID or title; default the active window |
| `target` | string | no | a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID |
| `within` | string | no | an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats |
| `what` | array of one of `state`, `layout`, `paint`, `metrics`, `dispatcher`, `interaction`, `session`, `schema`, `clipboard`, `summary`, `layout_reasons`, `resources`, `events` | no |  |

## `batch`

**Batch.** Several steps in one call with one combined reply: each step is {"tool": name, ...that tool's arguments} or an expect guard {"expect": "node"|"visual", target, state, value, exists, drawn}; the batch stops at the first failure or unmet expectation. terse gives each act's changes as counts.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | array of object | yes |  |
| `stop_on_error` | boolean | no |  |
| `terse` | boolean | no |  |

## `control`

**Control.** direct_begin and direct_end hold the interface with a take-back popup (launched --model-directed); suspend_input and resume_input in builds with the test controls; status.

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `direct_begin`, `direct_end`, `suspend_input`, `resume_input`, `status` | yes |  |
